title: Typing Show
description:
What is Typing Show?

Imagine practicing typing while feeling like part of a band. Learn to type faster while experiencing the adrenaline of a rhythm game. Learning is gradual and accompanied by sentimental melodies generated procedurally.

How does it work?

For every piano note, you must press a key on your computer keyboard. It’s a dual challenge: you have to press the right key at the right time.

Each note is a letter

You don't practice using standard words from your language; instead, you practice using piano notes. The sequence of letters is determined by the notes that make up the melody. Rather than practicing by writing text, you practice by playing the piano.

Letter distribution

Each letter corresponds to one or more piano notes. The arrangement of letters on the piano keyboard varies from lesson to lesson. You can use the same melody in any lesson you choose.

Melody generator

Instead of a fixed list of melodies, you have a procedural generator. You can create a virtually infinite number of new melodies. If you don't like a melody, simply press a button to generate another one.

Short, simple melodies

Each melody lasts between 13 and 19 seconds, contains a maximum of 64 notes, and repeats four times during the show. The melodies are purely instrumental and piano-based.

Ideal for all skill levels

There are 42 typing lessons, starting with 2 letters and progressing up to 30 letters. You can choose any lesson to start with. You can also customize the game's keyboard layout for different languages.

Features

• Fun training: Turn typing practice into an exciting musical activity.

• Endless music: Generate a brand-new melody with just a single click.

• Challenge: Beyond knowing where each key is, you must press it at the right moment.

• Simplicity: Each melody lasts 13–19 seconds and repeats four times.

• Learning: 42 typing lessons to help you improve gradually.

• Preparation: Dedicated practice areas to help you get ready.

• Customization: Various graphic settings and the option to change the keyboard characters.

• Exporting: You can save and export melodies in WAV and TXT formats.

Come and be a part of this typing show!
description_short: Learn typing in a musical rhythm game with endlessly generated melodies. Each note of the melody turns into a letter. Instead of writing text, practice as if you were playing the piano in a band.
